item.description:

Raw wavs. With LA Phiharmonic and Youth Orchestra of Los Angeles, conducted by Dudamel

Is this where the Parrotheads who have yet to die of cirrhosis ended up? Seemed the whole crowd was old winos. Only went for my girlfriend but she's starting to really not like the people either so maybe this is the last time. Just looking at this wav gives me a headache so it will be awhile before I give it a shot. Hopefully someone got an ALD feed. And of the first set because the Venezuelan musicians were the best part of the whole show but not the kind of thing drunk pop music fans could be expected to listen to.
